topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I was surprised this morning when I opened my mailbox to find a small, beautifully wrapped box. The card inside was from one of my former students, now all grown up and making their way in the world. They wrote about the lessons they remembered most, the times they felt supported, and how those moments have stayed with them. The gift itself—a lovely pen, something simple yet thoughtful—was a reminder of the power of words and the importance of writing. It's not every day that you get such a personal token, and it made me reflect on the impact we can have, often without realizing it. I’ll keep this pen on my desk, a silent but meaningful reminder of why I love teaching.
